subject: HAM-HKG two options please
body:
Hello,

please quote Hamburg (HAM) to Hong Kong (HKG), 4 pallets of measuring instruments, 620 kg, 2.4 cbm, ready 27.11., delivered to HAM by us.

Please give us two options so we can choose: your cheapest and your fastest, each with its all-in price in EUR and transit time.

Best regards
Jana Kraus
Logistics
Kraus Feinmechanik GmbH, Bremen
